<!-- pr-reviewer: 795733e7db839945f272589b67d46647a1649e64 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after #965; reviewed only what #967 adds on top of #965).

**What looks good**
- `xtask/src/assets.rs` maps `assets/posts/*.cps` and `assets/machines/*.mch` to suites that name the file, quote its stem, or walk the asset directory. It is small, has a provenance line, and has no unwrap/expect outside tests.
- `quick.rs` reports an asset no suite covers in the plan notes only, so it cannot fail the gate (dry-run exit 0). A deleted asset selects nothing.
- Process bookkeeping is consistent: PROCESS_VERSION is 18 (main 16, #965 17). The body has `Fixes #923`, `Changelog: none`, and a decision file at `docs/decisions/923-asset-gate.md`. No snapshot PNGs and no CHANGELOG edits.

**Local results** (macOS, the review worktree's own target; main was already merged in)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p xtask` | 42 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --dry-run`, `fanuc.cps` touched | before: no `crates/` change, so "no tests to run" (read from the base code path, not run). After: 38 app suites, e.g. `fanuc_post`, `conformance`, `c_axis_live`, each with its reason |
| same, `assets/machines/3axis-vmc.mch` touched | after: 16+ app suites (`machine_library`, `doosan_dnm_post`, `fanuc_post`, `tilt`, ...) |
| same, new `assets/posts/zzz_orphan.cps` | after: 8 suites picked because they walk `assets/posts`; exit 0 |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. The "NO SUITE covers this asset" report is close to unreachable for posts. Suites that walk `assets/posts` match every new `.cps` (see the `zzz_orphan.cps` run), so the line appears only if those walkers go away. It still errs toward over-selecting, never skipping. The decision file could say so.
2. Selection is a source-text heuristic (a quoted `"stem"` anywhere), so a short stem such as `tilt` may over-select. Harmless for a quick tier.
3. Not exercised: a real run of the selected suites (the PR says so too).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 795733e7db839945f272589b67d46647a1649e64 -->
**Independent review (second reviewer, not the author's account): Ready for the maintainer to merge, after #965.**

Its branch contains #965's head (2756f724), so I judged only what #967 adds: `xtask/src/assets.rs`, `asset_tests.rs`, and the `quick.rs` hook.

**What looks good**
- A changed `assets/posts/*.cps` / `assets/machines/*.mch` selects suites whose source names the file, quotes its stem, or walks the asset directory. A deleted asset selects nothing; an asset no suite covers is reported as `NO SUITE covers this asset` in the plan (a note, not a failure). No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests; regexes are escaped; no `.github`/build.rs/dependency change; PROCESS_VERSION 18.

**Local results** (trial-merged with main a6bd69d, no conflicts; head verified 795733e7)
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 43 passed. `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Dry runs, one file touched at a time (this PR vs main):

| touched file | main | PR |
|---|---|---|
| `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` | nothing | 38 app + post suites (names / quotes "fanuc") |
| `assets/posts/tormach-lathe.cps` | nothing | 12 app + post suites (only via suites that walk `assets/posts`) |
| `assets/machines/3axis-vmc.mch` | nothing | 20 app suites |
| new `assets/posts/zzz_orphan.cps` | nothing | 12 suites (walkers), exit 0 |
| `post/src/post/engine.rs`, `mod.rs`, sim `reach.rs`, motion `rings.rs` | same as #965: 10 / 37 / 4 / 4 | unchanged by this PR |

Nothing that was selected before is lost.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The "NO SUITE" line is nearly unreachable for posts while suites walk `assets/posts` (a script no suite names still selects the walkers; the line appears only if the walkers go away). It errs toward running more, which is the safe side.
- A `.cps` change selects no `post` crate unit tests of its own; the dialect suites cover it.
- PROCESS_VERSION: 18 assumes #965 (17) merges first. If this merges first, take 17; whichever is second merges main and takes the next free number (main 16 -> 17, then 18).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
